extracted.subtask_description: A short encyclopedia entry describing the Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP), the Canadian Intellectual Property Office's manual documenting procedures and practices for prosecution of patent applications under Canadian patent law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP) is a manual for patent agents and patent examiners, published by the Canadian Intellectual Property Office (CIPO). It documents the procedures and practices relative to the prosecution of patent applications under Canadian patent law for patent examiners, applicants, agents, and the public at large.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Occupies a position in Canadian patent law comparable to that occupied by the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) in United States patent law. (Page is a stub; follow the CIPO MOPOP link for full procedural guidance.)
